action_items: OPTIONAL / MINOR: The error-toast branch (testID='badge-share-toast-error') was verified by code inspection + a direct 403 API probe, but could not be exercised end-to-end via UI because client-side gating (canShare) prevents locked tiers from being tapped. If you want a live UI check, temporarily wrap api.createBadgeStory to throw ApiError(403) and confirm the toast appears — not blocking.

OPTIONAL: Expose an admin endpoint (POST /api/admin/users/{id}/grant_badge) so future testing agents can seed granted_category_badges without direct Mongo access. Also consider unifying the granted-badge format — see critical_code_review_comments.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 5906-5908 checks `f"{cat_id}:{tier}" in granted` (string format), while server.py line 463-469 `_build_category_badge_payload` iterates `granted` looking for dicts `{category, tier}`. These two code paths accept different formats for the same field. A user granted with the dict form will see the tier as unlocked in the modal UI but the POST /stories will 403; and vice-versa. Recommend consolidating on ONE format (preferably dict) and normalising both readers.

CategoryBadgesModal.tsx: the confirm overlay (line 298-327) and the toast (line 331-359) are correctly scoped inside the outer <Modal> so nested-modal alert suppression is avoided — good fix. The `pointerEvents` deprecation warning is triggered by the confirmBackdrop `pointerEvents="auto"` prop (line 299) — non-blocking but should migrate to `style.pointerEvents` at some point.

profile.tsx line 715-747: the layered avatarSrc fallback (primaryPhotoUri || primaryPhotoData || authPhoto) is correct. `authPhoto` comes from `user.primary_photo?.data` which is hydrated by /auth/me on session boot, so the first paint uses it. Consider inverting the order (authPhoto first, then myPhotos overrides once loaded) to avoid the theoretical case where `primaryPhotoUri` is stale after a photo swap — but current UX is already flicker-free per observation.
Regression: no other files touched between iter_68 and iter_69 code; nickname/onboarding/circle flows still green per prior iterations (not re-executed here).

success_rate.frontend: 100% for all in-scope scenarios (avatar hydration, own-shelf tap→confirm→success, own-shelf cancel, other-shelf gating, 403 backend contract, no-native-Alert). Error-toast UI branch only verified structurally.
